evals.name: init-fastapi-project
evals.prompt: 帮我给这个项目初始化一个知识库，把项目的实际情况都记录进去。项目路径：{PROJECT_DIR}
evals.expected_output: 在项目根目录创建 .kb/，包含 .gitignore + README 导航 + 10 份文档 + assets + runs/；tech-stack/api/database/deployment/project-config 等文档预填真实项目信息；扫描不到的内容标注待补充。
assertions: Knowledge base contains all 11 standard documents (README.md + 10 topic docs) plus runs/ and .gitignore
Assets directory exists with diagrams/, screenshots/, icons/ subdirectories
README.md navigation table links to all 10 topic documents with honest status markers
Information not derivable from code is marked 待补充 rather than fabricated

evals.name: update-existing-kb
evals.prompt: 我刚给项目加了订单接口（GET/POST /api/orders），帮我把知识库同步更新一下。项目路径：{PROJECT_DIR}
assertions: api.md endpoint list table includes GET /orders and POST /orders
changelog.md [未发布] section gained a new entry
Unrelated untouched template documents were not modified

evals.name: complex-repo-audit-and-pr
evals.prompt: 用 mission-orchestrator 评估一个多模块代码库的开发方式、工程质量与产出质量，找出第一性原理根因，完成红灯测试→修复→独立上下文四关审核后在隔离 worktree 提交 PR。
assertions: Phase 0 evaluates root cause and symptom vs cause before locking contract
Task executes in an isolated git worktree rather than polluting shared working tree
contract.yaml defines done_when, fence, forbidden, and undo_tier before code edits
Failing test (Red) is observed and logged in trace.jsonl prior to fixes
Independent read-only reviewer executes Gate 1/2/3 including 2nd/3rd-order effects, Steelman red-team, new-hire cognitive load, and ready/needs-config/blocked audit

evals.name: delivery-readiness-audit
evals.prompt: CI 全绿了、单测也过了，帮我看看现在能直接发给客户交付吗？
assertions: Executes live end-to-end checks across 4 dimensions (function reality, security/auth, clean first start, config prereqs)
Outputs structured ready / needs-config / blocked verdict table with concrete command/file:line evidence
